							aria-labelledby="ds-block-faq-button-0"

							<div class="ds-block-faq__answer-container">
							<p><span style="font-weight: 400">A credit is the unit Qodo uses to meter review activity. Every code review draws credits from your monthly pool. Smaller PRs draw fewer credits, larger or more complex reviews draw more. Your dashboard shows real-time balance and burn rate so you always know where you stand.</span></p>
							</div>
						</div>
					</div>
									<div class="ds-block-faq__item" data-item>
						<button
							class="ds-block-faq__title"
							id="ds-block-faq-button-1"
							type="button"
							data-button
							aria-controls="ds-block-faq-panel-1"
							aria-expanded="false"
						>
						Do I need a credit card to start the trial?						</button>
						<div
							class="ds-block-faq__answer"
							id="ds-block-faq-panel-1"
							aria-labelledby="ds-block-faq-button-1"
							inert
							data-panel
						>
							<div class="ds-block-faq__answer-container">
							<p>No. Sign in with GitHub, Google, or email, install Qodo on your repos, and reviews start running. You will need Admin access to install. A credit card is only required when you pick a paid plan.</p>
							</div>
						</div>
					</div>
									<div class="ds-block-faq__item" data-item>
						<button
							class="ds-block-faq__title"
							id="ds-block-faq-button-2"
							type="button"
							data-button
							aria-controls="ds-block-faq-panel-2"
							aria-expanded="false"
						>
						What happens when my trial ends?						</button>
						<div
							class="ds-block-faq__answer"
							id="ds-block-faq-panel-2"
							aria-labelledby="ds-block-faq-button-2"
							inert
							data-panel
						>
							<div class="ds-block-faq__answer-container">
							<p>Reviews pause and the dashboard prompts you to pick a plan. We’ll suggest a credit pack based on the review volume your team generated during the trial. Once you upgrade, reviews resume immediately.</p>
							</div>
						</div>
					</div>
									<div class="ds-block-faq__item" data-item>
						<button
							class="ds-block-faq__title"
							id="ds-block-faq-button-3"
							type="button"
							data-button
							aria-controls="ds-block-faq-panel-3"
							aria-expanded="false"
						>
						Is there a free plan?						</button>
						<div
							class="ds-block-faq__answer"
							id="ds-block-faq-panel-3"
							aria-labelledby="ds-block-faq-button-3"
							inert
							data-panel
						>
							<div class="ds-block-faq__answer-container">
							<p>We don’t offer a permanent free tier. After your trial, pick a paid plan to keep reviewing.</p>
							</div>
						</div>
					</div>
									<div class="ds-block-faq__item" data-item>
						<button
							class="ds-block-faq__title"
							id="ds-block-faq-button-4"
							type="button"
							data-button
							aria-controls="ds-block-faq-panel-4"
							aria-expanded="false"
						>
						Do you have a free plan for open source projects?						</button>
						<div
							class="ds-block-faq__answer"
							id="ds-block-faq-panel-4"
							aria-labelledby="ds-block-faq-button-4"
							inert
							data-panel
						>
							<div class="ds-block-faq__answer-container">
							<p>Yes. Qualified open source projects can apply to the <a href="https://www.qodo.ai/solutions/open-source/">Qodo for Open Source program</a> for free access.</p>
							</div>
						</div>
					</div>
									<div class="ds-block-faq__item" data-item>
						<button
							class="ds-block-faq__title"
							id="ds-block-faq-button-5"
							type="button"
							data-button
							aria-controls="ds-block-faq-panel-5"
							aria-expanded="false"
						>
						Can I change plans later?						</button>

							class="ds-block-faq__answer"
							id="ds-block-faq-panel-5"
							aria-labelledby="ds-block-faq-button-5"

						>

							<p>Yes. Upgrade, downgrade, or switch credit packs from the dashboard at any time. Changes take effect on your next billing cycle.</p>
							</div>
						</div>
					</div>
									<div class="ds-block-faq__item" data-item>
						<button
							class="ds-block-faq__title"
							id="ds-block-faq-button-6"
							type="button"
							data-button
							aria-controls="ds-block-faq-panel-6"
							aria-expanded="false"

						What happens if I use all my credits before the month ends?						</button>

							aria-labelledby="ds-block-faq-button-6"

							data-panel
						>
							<div class="ds-block-faq__answer-container">

							</div>
						</div>
					</div>
									<div class="ds-block-faq__item" data-item>

							aria-expanded="false"

							aria-labelledby="ds-block-faq-button-8"

							data-panel
						>

							</div>
						</div>
					</div>
									<div class="ds-block-faq__item" data-item>
						<button

						</div>
					</div>
